notes.title: Improvement Update #21: Paludarium Inventory Table
notes.notes:
Hello, Aquascapers! 

To enhance your gaming experience and improve the quality of our existing features, we are updating the Paludarium feature by adding a table that will represent the inventory of Paludarium items you have collected from various areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/f19f93227b45178f68225dc14cd21a4ab6cc6c66.png[/img]
With this new feature, players will find it easier to monitor the items they have gathered, as these items will be displayed prominently in the center of the room near the Paludarium that is being processed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/40697aa91f60e548ccd5670965998ff1742f555e.png[/img]
Similar to the Aquascape inventory items, the Paludarium items also have the same limitations. In the previous update, these limitations were not visible, but now that they are represented by a table, the limitations we have set are more clearly defined. We hope you enjoy this new feature and find it helpful in managing your Paludarium collections.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/7e4547cc0a30459297c6782d9df757a61d570643.png[/img]
Additionally, we want to remind you that we have updated the game with the Paludarium feature, which can be accessed once you have unlocked License S and the final Expansion Upgrade for the Paludarium. With the Paludarium and License S unlocked, you will be able to collect Paludarium items and complete License S Objectives to create the best Paludarium.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/6567c105d4eb6bd48173dd1848c68b5dfc76b06f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/daf5b9299eaa90a6510b104e4a592fb5cac65d8a.png[/img]
To access the latest enhancements, simply restart your Steam client or utilize the verify integration option in the game's properties. [b]Check for the new version marked as v2024.23.1 [e0102e7], visible in the bottom left corner of the main menu.[/b]

If you encounter any further issues or have additional feedback, please feel free to share them in the discussion.

Happy Aquascaping! 🌿🐠

notes.title: Improvement Update #20: Road to Paludarium - Level S License
notes.notes:
Hello, Aquascapers! 

We're excited to introduce the Level S License, the pinnacle of achievement in the world of aquascaping. As the highest level license for creating aquascapes, obtaining the [b]Level S License[/b] signifies a remarkable milestone in a player's journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/7e1b1ca7b15c7ff514bcb668f61a6803054c9c3b.png[/img]

With the Level S License, players gain the confidence to tackle missions of the highest difficulty, including the intricate and challenging paludarium projects. This license grants them access to a new realm of possibilities, empowering them to push the boundaries of their creativity and expertise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/6567c105d4eb6bd48173dd1848c68b5dfc76b06f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/a1ab21b965f0b88d77614d67043659aaad385202.png[/img]

Unlocking the Level S License is not just about achieving a badge of honor; it's also about unlocking new avenues for exploration and growth. However, this achievement comes with a requirement: players must also unlock the Paludarium Business to build their paludarium and collect the necessary items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/e6367930a178a54469acdae9bd414bdb95c2386c.png[/img]

One of the exciting opportunities that come with the Level S License is the chance to participate in exclusive paludarium auctions. Here, players can showcase their masterpieces to fellow aquascape enthusiasts, gaining recognition and admiration for their exceptional work. These auctions provide a platform for players to exhibit their talent and ingenuity, further fueling their passion for the art of aquascaping.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/99969c829aafe0b2b5f4c1f04c852498ff99f18f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/d89bdadd0ff1a795ebf8f7cc6ba5b62851c01cf8.png[/img]

To access the latest enhancements, simply restart your Steam client or utilize the verify integration option in the game's properties. [b]Look out for the new version marked as v2024.18.4 [3bab3cd], visible in the bottom left corner of the main menu.[/b]

If you encounter any further issues or have additional feedback, please feel free to share them in the discussion.

Happy Aquascaping! 🌿🐠

notes.title: Improvement Update #18: Paludarium Tank Variations
notes.notes:
Hello, Aquascapers! 

In Aquascapers, players now have the opportunity to explore [b]three unique tank design variations[/b] within the Paludarium system. These variations offer players the flexibility to choose the tank design that best suits their vision and preferences. Once a tank design is selected, players can then proceed to customize their Paludarium by selecting and arranging paludarium items that complement their chosen design or replicate specific natural environments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/cc48f359d474b502686bb078d271466464185914.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/1fd07a67def5c81512cf88da3052bd5c640ba885.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/c9f7e8eb87e107606f0c942886369a6c350d119c.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/3331348be1afd6b81993ea7f316b58e739a3a8b9.png[/img]

To bring their Paludarium to life, players will need to collect rock and wood items from the wild. These materials are essential for creating the foundation of the Paludarium and adding visual interest to the overall design. While acquiring rock and wood items may require exploration and effort, they play a crucial role in shaping the aesthetics of the Paludarium.

In addition to rock and wood items, players can also incorporate fish and plants into their Paludarium ecosystem. These aquatic and terrestrial elements can be sourced from the wild or obtained through cultivation and breeding efforts at the home base. By carefully selecting and curating fish and plants, players can enhance the biodiversity and visual appeal of their Paludarium, creating a dynamic and vibrant miniature ecosystem.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/e8e515c521ea096f3cc28bae0accc3a9c6432ffa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/daf5b9299eaa90a6510b104e4a592fb5cac65d8a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/ab122761974c09c67042c2acfed7f17d7b147dc9.png[/img]

With the introduction of paludarium tank variations, players can unleash their creativity and design unique Paludariums that reflect their individual style and imagination. Whether recreating a natural habitat or experimenting with new design concepts, the possibilities are endless in Aquascapers' Paludarium system.

To access the latest enhancements, simply restart your Steam client or utilize the verify integration option in the game's properties. [b]Look out for the new version marked as v2024.18.4 [3bab3cd], visible in the bottom left corner of the main menu.[/b]

notes.title: Improvement Update #17: Paludarium System
notes.notes:
Hello, Aquascapers! 

In our latest update, we're thrilled to unveil the [b]Paludarium System[/b], a captivating addition to the Aquascapers universe. The Paludarium System brings a captivating twist to Aquascapers, offering players the opportunity to create unique aquatic landscapes in much larger fish tank. Players can dive into the Paludarium work process, which takes place in the expansion room adjacent to the main home base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/1fd07a67def5c81512cf88da3052bd5c640ba885.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/d66b592b4233e8a41219d9dbc3b113bc2d059fd1.png[/img]

While the Paludarium system shares similarities with the aquascape system, there are notable differences. One such distinction is the introduction of Paludarium special missions and unique paludarium items, particularly rocks and woods. To unlock the Paludarium system, players must first attain the [b]Level S License[/b] and [b]unlock the business expansion for Paludarium Business.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/7e1b1ca7b15c7ff514bcb668f61a6803054c9c3b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/e6367930a178a54469acdae9bd414bdb95c2386c.png[/img]

Once these prerequisites are met, players will receive a Paludarium mission email and they get permission to search for Paludarium-specific rocks and woods items in the wild. Unlike regular aquarium decorations, rocks and woods items are specially designed for arranging larger paludariums, adding an extra layer of depth and complexity to the landscape. These items can be collected from the wild, adding an exciting element of exploration to the gameplay experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/99969c829aafe0b2b5f4c1f04c852498ff99f18f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/90abbb1de8e8678f89e73a8d2c4f7bdf6455ea7c.png[/img]

In addition to rocks and woods, players can use the same plants and fish as those used in aquascaping to populate their paludariums. These items can be sourced from the wild or obtained through [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2299400/view/4178853497458427651]cultivation [/url]and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2299400/view/4178853497478629615]breeding[/url]. 

Upon completing their Paludarium, players can participate in auctions to sell their creations to fellow Paludarium enthusiasts. This interactive feature allows players to select from available auctions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/97d6d680a17890ad8b62cdc531c77dbb3bce0e45.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/d89bdadd0ff1a795ebf8f7cc6ba5b62851c01cf8.png[/img]

However, the challenge of making a paludarium lies in its scale and complexity, requiring players to hone their skills and creativity to overcome the obstacles. Despite the challenges, creating a paludarium offers a rewarding experience that can significantly improve players' skills and abilities in aquatic landscaping. Get ready to embark on this exciting journey and discover the endless possibilities of the Paludarium System in Aquascapers!

To access the latest enhancements, simply restart your Steam client or utilize the verify integration option in the game's properties. [b]Look out for the new version marked as v2024.18.4 [3bab3cd], visible in the bottom left corner of the main menu.[/b]

If you encounter any further issues or have additional feedback, please feel free to share them in the discussion.

Happy Aquascaping! 🌿🐠

notes.title: Improvement Update #15: Road to Paludarium - Plant Cultivation
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/1c9b88a94ddc8eb706b7790f614f86d7937e1b46.png[/img]

Hello, Aquascapers!

In our latest game update, we're thrilled to introduce the [b]Plant Cultivation[/b] feature to Aquascapers. Now, players have the opportunity to unleash their inner botanist and cultivate a variety of plants right from the comfort of their home base. To begin cultivating plants, players must first upgrade their [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2299400/view/4178853497460990729]Room Expansion[/url] at home base, unlocking the new room where all plant cultivation activities will take place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/8b376288d34caa94f7e2987ab6599969207578e1.png[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/8513653744b5565e64e555de757695dc372b87bf.png[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/77d5cc19426ca3a484f4d8e1be1a7b42c434ec08.png[/img]

Unlocking the plant expansion feature requires players to have sufficient story points and money, adding a new dimension to their gameplay experience. Once unlocked, players can embark on a botanical journey, nurturing their plants through various stages of growth, from small seedlings to thriving botanical wonders. This immersive process allows players to witness the evolution of their plants firsthand, adding a sense of satisfaction and accomplishment to their aquascaping endeavors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/6e4508156a942895532adfd2ca9c46818557713e.png[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/1db713c8879545d8624ca8aaff5af5e2818e68a7.png[/img]

After the plants have matured and been harvested, the cultivation box will be emptied, ready to be used for another round of cultivation. This efficient cycle ensures a continuous supply of plant items without the need to venture into the forest for resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/b80fcf0e11c009958702b6dca131c327522cec59.png[/img]

One of the most convenient aspects of plant cultivation is the ability to obtain plant items without the need to venture into the forest. With plants readily available in their home base, players can save time and effort while still reaping the rewards of their green-fingered efforts. Whether you're a seasoned gardener or just starting out, plant cultivation in Aquascapers offers a rewarding and enjoyable experience for players of all levels.

So, get ready to roll up your sleeves, and watch your botanical creations come to life in Aquascapers.

Happy Aquascaping! 🌿

notes.title: Improvement Update #14: Update on "Fish Breeding" Terms
notes.notes:
In response to valuable feedback from our community, we're pleased to announce an important update to our game: the term "Fish Cultivation" has been officially changed to "[b]Fish Breeding[/b]." This update reflects our commitment to accuracy and authenticity in representing aquascaping practices.

Upon careful consideration and further research prompted by player input, we confirmed that "Fish Breeding" is indeed the more appropriate term for the process depicted in our game. As such, we have swiftly implemented this change to ensure alignment with industry standards and best practices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/a954690c8915a68243316dd13f9039f41d098500.png[/img]

This update underscores our dedication to customer collaboration in the development of our game products. We greatly value the insights and contributions of our players, recognizing their role in shaping the evolution of our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/5cb8e198c832bf46c79d3afdfcbdbffa0245d925.png[/img]

Moving forward, players can expect to see the term "Fish Breeding" used consistently throughout the game interface and accompanying documentation. We believe that this change will enhance the overall gaming experience and provide a more accurate portrayal of the aquascaping activities depicted in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/1dee57fc7d4c2a6d0e9f3c8b0d8f4c2caf967291.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/a7b3007ca622a50beefed8d683573b74b69d5bd8.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/08acaf3505253c2ef8202bab25fe00cd61f1fa87.png[/img]

As always, we remain open to further input and feedback from our community. Your insights are invaluable in driving continuous improvement and innovation in our game. Together, let's continue to cultivate an engaging and authentic gaming experience that resonates with aquascapers worldwide.

Thank you for your ongoing support, and happy Aquascaping! 🌿🐟

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2299400?utm_source=steam_devlog&utm_campaign=devlog&utm_medium=web&utm_content=development_update_feb

notes.title: Improvement Update #13: Road to Paludarium - Fish Cultivation
notes.notes:
Hello, Aquascapers!

As we continue to expand and evolve our aquascaping ventures, we're excited to introduce the next stage of business development: [b]Fish Cultivation[/b]. This significant milestone follows the successful implementation of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2299400/view/4178853497460990729]Room Expansion[/url] and offers players the opportunity to unlock new possibilities within their aquascape business. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/af9d6320f5a991799a2515fd38e10afb0b1e820c.png[/img]

Fish Cultivation takes place within the expansion room, conveniently located adjacent to the main home base. Within this designated area, players will find five cultivation boxes designed to nurture fish from their juvenile stages to adulthood. This streamlined process eliminates the need for traditional fishing methods, allowing players to efficiently cultivate their desired fish species without the hassle of fishing in the wild.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/c5d241e4b352faac7a5d5d7484563ea81f32f919.png[/img]

One of the key benefits of fish cultivation is its efficiency. By cultivating fish, players can obtain their desired species reliably and save valuable time that would otherwise be spent fishing in various locations. Unlike traditional fishing, where multiple attempts may be required to capture specific species, fish cultivation provides a more direct and streamlined approach to acquiring aquatic companions for your aquascape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/73fc425d35e1745883ca1af8fafedea6d9ba89c0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/db04cd9afdf968e44dd0ad2f9dbdb767c852a634.png[/img]

While fish cultivation offers numerous advantages, it's essential to consider the limitations of traditional fishing methods. Fishing in the wild can be time-consuming and unpredictable, requiring players to invest significant effort in locating and capturing desired fish species. Additionally, identifying the correct fishing locations can pose a challenge, further complicating the process.

By embracing this feature, players can enhance their efficiency, streamline their operations, and unlock new opportunities for creativity and success in the world of aquascaping.

Prepare to immerse yourself in the captivating world of fish cultivation and elevate your aquascaping game to new heights. Happy aquascaping! 🐟✨

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2299400?utm_source=steam_devlog&utm_campaign=devlog&utm_medium=web&utm_content=development_update_feb

notes.title: Improvement Update #5: FOV Settings & Additional Configuration
notes.notes:
Greetings, Aquascapers! 🐟🌿

We express our gratitude for your continuous support and valuable feedback during the Early Access period of Aquascapers. Numerous reports and suggestions have been carefully noted in our backlog, and we are actively working on prioritizing and implementing solutions for many of them.

Here are some new updates regarding the game included in Improvement Update #5:

1. [b]FOV (Field of View) Settings[/b]: In response to feedback from many players, we have added FOV settings, allowing players to adjust the FOV to their most comfortable level, supporting extended gaming sessions. The default FOV at the beginning of the game is 70, but you can customize it according to your preferences within the range of 66 - 80. However, it seems we need your input to determine the optimal value to reach comfortable level. Please share your thoughts on this matter in the  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2299400/discussions/0/4137186960643506078/]discussion forum here[/url].

notes.title: Improvement Update #2: Revisit Camera Sensitivity & Minor Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Hello, Aquascapers! 🐟🌿

It's been several days since we launched the Early Access for Aquascapers, and we truly appreciate the enthusiasm from all of you as players, supporting us by providing valuable feedback to the game. We have carefully noted down many of your feedback and identified various issues that you encountered along the way.

In this update, we addressed the following:

[b]1. Revisiting Camera Sensitivity:[/b]
After our last update regarding Camera Sensitivity adjustment, some players still reported experiencing dizziness or discomfort. To address this, we attempted to change the default value of camera sensitivity and provide the camera sensitivity settings as well. Before this update, we set the initial value of 0.75; now, it is 0.5. However, it seems we need your input to determine the optimal value or if there are other factors contributing to the discomfort. Please share your thoughts on this matter in the  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2299400/discussions/0/4137186960643506078/]discussion forum here[/url].

[b]2. Fixing Altingia Forest Achievement:[/b]
We resolved the achievement issue related to Altingia Forest. All players should now be able to obtain this achievement as they progress through the tutorial or skip it. For those with more progress, simply update the version and continue or load the game to acquire the achievement.

[b]3. Updating Several In-Game Text:[/b]
We identified some typos and text that needed clearer directions to provide better information to players. As a result, we updated several texts to ensure our information is clearer, and descriptions are improved.

notes.title: UX Update: Introducing "My Story" Menu for Clear Goals and Unlockable Content
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/d48cd5e7fbc8635f215702302812de2b58dcdebc.png[/img]
Hello, Aquascapers!

We're thrilled to share a noteworthy user experience (UX) update with you in Aquascape Simulator. Listening to player feedback, we've rolled out the "[b]My Story[/b]" menu accessible through your Tablet Menu. This update is designed to offer clear goals and requirements, ensuring a smooth journey as you progress toward becoming a skilled aquascape business owner.

The "[b]My Story[/b]" menu serves as a comprehensive guide, providing a structured path for your aquascaping journey. This feature is geared to keep you focused and motivated, facilitating your advancement in the game and enhancing your aquascape designs. 

[h3]Unlockable Upgrades, Features, and Content[/h3]
"My Story" menu also sheds light on the requirements for unlocking upgrades, features, and additional content. You get a transparent view of what's needed to access new tools, equipment, plant species, hardscapes, and more. This knowledge empowers you to strategize your gameplay, plan your resources, and make informed decisions for efficient progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/e7698bcc778953d4146f9772c5240a0b8949dcf7.png[/img]

[h3]Track Your Milestones[/h3]
Beyond guiding your aquascaping journey, the “My Story” menu acts as a personal log of your milestones. Celebrate your progress and reflect on your accomplishments as you traverse various stages of aquascape mastery. It visually represents your growth and dedication as an aquascape business owner. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44354852/8c55717dbc541bc7b800311f5541aed0abeac260.png[/img]

With the introduction of the "My Story" menu, Aquascape Simulator has become an even more immersive and rewarding experience. Take charge of your aquascaping destiny, follow the clear goals, and unlock the upgrades, features, and content that will elevate your skills and creativity as an aquascape business owner.

Thank you for joining us on this journey. If you have any questions or thoughts about the features discussed or the Aquascape Simulator game, feel free to leave a comment or post on our discussion forum. Don't forget to add Aquascape Simulator to your wishlist for the latest news and updates. We appreciate your support and look forward to creating an amazing experience for all our players. Stay tuned for more updates!

Cheers!
